public_rationale: The revenue figures hold: three direct customers supplied 44% of first-half FY2027 revenue, and one supplied 16% of Q2 revenue. The receivables claim is wrong. NVIDIA disclosed five customers accounting for 70% of receivables at July 26; the largest three accounted for 49%. The filing establishes substantial concentration, but not the stated three-customer receivables figure.
limitations: The filing labels the financial statements unaudited.
Direct customers may be intermediaries serving several ultimate buyers.
The supplied schema has only one contract metric_scope object; this claim combines revenue flows with a receivable stock. Component scopes are recorded separately on the evidence items.
The secondary article is used only for the revenue total corroborated by the filing; its receivables wording is not relied upon.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: NVIDIA has a revenue concentration problem, with 44% of first-half FY2027 revenue from three customers and 70% of Q2 receivables from three customers.

statement.excerpt: NVIDIA already has its own revenue concentration problem — 44% of its first half FY2027 revenues came from three customers, and in Q2 FY2027, 70% of its accounts receivables were from three customers, with 16% of its revenues coming from one.

from_speaker: 44% of its first half FY2027 revenues
in Q2 FY2027, 70% of its accounts receivables
16% of its revenues coming from one
our_interpretation: The 16% figure refers to second-quarter FY2027 revenue, consistent with the sentence's immediate context.
Customers means NVIDIA's disclosed direct customers, not necessarily the ultimate users of its chips.
Accounts receivable is measured at the second-quarter closing date; revenue is measured over the specified half-year or quarter.
Revenue concentration problem is treated as a description of the numerical concentration, not a separately measurable claim about an unacceptable level of risk.

This compound claim combines revenue flows and a receivable stock. The contract's stock_or_flow field describes the main revenue component; the receivable component is identified separately in the measurement requirements and evidence scope.
criteria.support_condition: The FY2027 second-quarter filing reports three direct customers totaling 44% of first-half revenue, three customers totaling 70% of quarter-end receivables, and one customer supplying 16% of second-quarter revenue.
criteria.contradiction_condition: The same-period disclosure reports a materially different percentage or customer count for any component. Correct revenue figures alongside an incorrect receivables figure warrant a mixed outcome.
